lane: بَطُؤَ 1 , aor. ﹹ, inf. n. بُطْءٌ (S, Msb, K) and بَطَآءَةٌ, with fet-h and medd, (Msb,) or بِطَآءٌ, like كِتَابٌ; (K;) and ↓ابطأ; (S, Msb, K;) _He was,_ or _became, slow, tardy, dilatory, late,_ or _backward; contr. of_ أَسْرَعَ; (K;) in his going or course, and in his gait [&c.]: (TA:) or the latter is said of a man; (S, Msb;) meaning [as above; or] _his coming was late,_ or _backward;_ (Msb;) [and is app. elliptical, for ابطأ مَشْيَهُ _he made his pace,_ or _going, slow,_ &c.; or the like; see اسرع:] and بَطُؤَ [denotes what is as it were an innate quality; see, again, أَسْرَعَ; or] is said of one's coming; [meaning _it was,_ or _became, slow,_ &c.;] (S, Msb;) بُطْءٌ being the _contr. of_ سُرْعَةٌ. (S.) One should not say ↓أَبْطَيْتَ for أَبْطَأْتَ. (S.) [See also 6.] === بَطُءَ ذَا خُرُوجًا: see بُطْآنَ.
